label: t-tau biomarker measured in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) using Lumipulse assays - Insight46 phase 2
meta_rows: t-tau biomarker measured in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) using Lumipulse assays - Insight46 phase 2

Insight46 phase 2 CSF biomarker analysis - details of the commercially available Lumipulse AB40, AB42, p-tau181 and t-tau assays are given in the kit inserts and they were all used as per the manufacturer’s instructions. Measurements were undertaken in singlicate, using two reagent batches: the first 72 samples were assayed in 2019 for an interim analysis (1) and the remaining 62 samples were assayed in 2021. CSF was not collected at phase 1.
cat_rows: This category contains measurements in CSF of amyloid-beta 40, amyloid-beta 42, ptau 181, total tau, ptau-217 collected as part of the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values and distribution outside 5th and 95th percentiles removed from both the plot and the statistics above.
